frame.unit: first-parent squash-merge commit on main; MAIN = C^, PR = C
frame.cost_relevant_rule: diff touches a model .sql, a macro .sql, or project config

split_rule.assignment: first DEV_N usable in merge order, then next HOLDOUT_N; remainder is reserve for bug-invalidated holdout cases

realised.reserve_note: Sampling stopped as soon as the split was full, per the chronological rule, so the reserve list is empty. If a holdout case is invalidated by a genuine harness bug, the replacement is the next PR in  (merge order), reconstructed on demand.
